scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent repeated the customer's problem statement verbatim at [01:54] rather than paraphrasing into their own words.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Agent attempted to deflect responsibility at [02:16] by telling the customer that third-party camera hardware is outside S-Net remit and instructing him to contact the camera manufacturer.

grader.scenario: Smart home security camera failing 5GHz connection; separate 2.4GHz IoT guest SSID established; agent gives verbatim echo (paraphrase FAIL) and tells customer to contact camera manufacturer (ownership FAIL)
grader.notes: The agent assisted the caller in establishing a dedicated 2.4GHz network for smart security cameras. However, the agent failed Paraphrasing by echoing the customer's opening explanation almost word for word rather than synthesizing it into their own words, and failed Took Ownership of the Problem at minute 3 by attempting to deflect responsibility, telling Sean that third-party camera hardware is outside S-Net support scope and that he should contact the camera manufacturer.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:22] Agent: 'I am so sorry to hear about the burglary nearby, Sean. Feeling vulnerable in your own home is horrible and stressful, so let us get these cameras connected...' - Warm and immediate empathy acknowledging fear and urgency.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:54] Agent: 'So you are having a massive headache trying to connect three new smart outdoor security cameras to your S-Net Hub router because the setup app on your phone keeps saying unable to connect to 5GHz network, 2.4GHz required.' - Verbatim echo of customer's opening words without synthesis.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [02:16] Agent: 'Well, third-party internet-of-things devices and home security cameras are strictly outside S-Net's technical remit, so you really ought to phone the Eufy customer support helpline directly instead.' - Deflection of router setup to third party.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [03:02] Agent: 'What model of S-Net Hub do you have connected to your master telephone socket?' - Probing router specifications to determine band steering capabilities.
